mapper.sql: SELECT r.*, COALESCE(hb.booking_code, ao.order_code) AS booking_code, COALESCE(hb.currency, ao.currency) AS currency, s.starts_at AS new_slot_starts_at, hb.hotel_id, ao.activity_booking_id FROM booking_change_requests r LEFT JOIN hotel_bookings hb ON hb.id = r.hotel_booking_id LEFT JOIN activity_orders ao ON ao.id = r.activity_order_id LEFT JOIN activity_slots s ON s.id = r.new_slot_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO booking_change_requests (id, booking_type, hotel_booking_id, activity_order_id, organization_id, requested_by, new_check_in_date, new_check_out_date, new_adults, new_children, new_slot_id, message, status, price_before, price_after, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{bookingType}, #{hotelBookingId}, #{activityOrderId}, #{organizationId}, #{requestedBy}, #{newCheckInDate}, #{newCheckOutDate}, #{newAdults}, #{newChildren}, #{newSlotId}, #{message}, #{status}, #{priceBefore}, #{priceAfter}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: WHERE r.hotel_booking_id = #{hotelBookingId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
WHERE r.activity_order_id = #{activityOrderId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
ORDER BY r.created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking_change_requests r LEFT JOIN hotel_bookings hb ON hb.id = r.hotel_booking_id LEFT JOIN activity_orders ao ON ao.id = r.activity_order_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking_change_requests r WHERE r.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND r.status = 'REQUESTED'
